claims.text: The Assembly reports that King Tupou VI appointed Lord Tangi Interim Speaker of the Legislative Assembly effective Saturday 20 November 2021, to preside over and lead the constitutional process to elect the Prime Minister Designate from the representatives elected at the 18 November 2021 general election. It states that the writ of election must be returned by 2 December 2021; that invitations to nominate follow within 10 days of its return and nominations must be received within 14 days of it; and that a secret-ballot meeting of the elected representatives follows within 3 days of the close of nominations.
claims.uncertainty: A procedural notice issued before the selection. It records no result and no appointment or effective date for a Prime Minister. The interim Speaker appointment is not imported as a Speaker holder observation.
